description: 【京都府】鉄道駅一覧 [railways and stations] is a dataset listed in BODIK Open Data Catalogue Service (data.bodik.jp), Japanese local governments, an open data portal, published or maintained by 京都府. 出典：国土地理院ウェブサイト（ gsi. go. jp/）、【京都府】鉄道乗車人員（ bodik. jp/dataset/260002tokeisyo1001）. Coverage: 京都府. The portal files it under the publisher 京都府. Its tags are 位置情報, 鉄道, 鉄道駅, ３つ星オープンデータ, ４つ星オープンデータ. It offers 3 resource(s) in csv, rdf, xlsx. The portal shows 2022-04-18 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Japanese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support rail network and station studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-jp-bodik-portal.
